title: The Shell | 5BR Rental in Seaside | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The Shell is a signature 5BR Seagrove Beach home featuring a private heated pool and luxury designer decor. This 30A rental sleeps 14 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: The Shell by Royal Destinations Location: Seaside Address: 31 Wakulla Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 32459 Details: New ownership and new name with updates throughout! Located directly in Seaside proper, The Shell (formerly Something Blue) offers large living spaces for family and friends to enjoy. Whether you're planning a trip with extended family or friends, each of your guests will have plenty of privacy in the 7 bedrooms, each featuring a spacious en suite bathroom and ample closet space. Steps outside the front door, guests can enjoy the croquet lawn, pickleball court, the family pool, tennis, and workout facilities. Take a short stroll down Seaside Ave to the many shops and restaurants of Seaside or an even shorter stroll down Savannah Street to the Tupelo Street Pavilion beach access. Guests of all ages will never run out of activities when staying at The Shell. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Take in the 360-degree views of Seaside from the tower! -Distance to Beach Access: 352 yards (4 minute walk)! -Downtown Village of Seaside: 352 yards (4-minute walk)! -Parking Spaces: 2 -Dining Accommodations: Main Floor: 12 / Top Floor 8 -Coffee Maker Available -Located next to a green area, croquet lawn, and pickleball court -Features appx. 4,300 square feet with 7 private bathrooms -Tower with 360 views -(7) Smart TVs -Bar room with a Beverage Fridge, Sink, and Large Game Table -Outdoor shower & charcoal grill -(8) Complimentary Bikes -Extra large storage space under the house loaded with beach toys. -Located across the lawn from Tennis, Pickleball, Sand Volleyball, Basketball, Playground, and the Fitness Center Seaside Community Highlights: -(3) Community Pools -Tennis Courts *Pay as you play. -Pickleball Courts *Pay as you play. -Croquet Lawn -Seaside Private Residential Beach Access at Tupelo Pavilion -Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 16 7 Bedrooms / 7.5 Bathrooms First Level (Ground Level): -Bedroom 1: Bunk Bed Full/Full, Detached Bath -Mudroom Second Level (Main): -Bedroom 2: (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Large Spa Shower/Two Vanities), TV -Kitchen, Living, Dining Half Bath Third Level: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Spa Shower), TV -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo), TV -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo), TV -Bedroom 6: Bunk Room Twin/Full/Full, Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo), TV -Laundry Room Fourth Level: -Bedroom 7: (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Large Shower) Sitting Area, TV -Large Family Room, Dining Table, Wet Bar, TV Fifth Level: -Sunroom -Sundeck Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
